bugs.text: Load crash: makeSprite(SPR.fighterA, CAPPAL) passes a canvas as 'rows'; 'for (const r of rows)' throws 'rows is not iterable'. The script aborts before resetGame() and requestAnimationFrame() (671-672), so nothing is ever drawn or updated. Confirmed by result.json pageerror and all-black screenshots.

Formation builder cannot work: COLS entries are single points, cols.length is undefined, i%undefined is NaN, cols[NaN] is undefined, col.x throws. Pressing Enter would throw every frame (nextStage called again each frame via 421-422).
G.mode='chalResult' has no update case; stageTimer never counts down, so the challenging-stage result screen never ends (soft-lock).
updateChallenging never calls updatePlayer, so the player cannot move or fire during a challenging stage.
No 'GAME OVER' text and no hit-results screen are ever drawn.
capIdOf returns the boss id, so the 'freed' lookup finds the dead boss itself; rescue and dual fighter can never happen.
Enemies are created without an id; escortIds, captured.bossId and enemy lookups by id all compare undefined.
Tractor beam is drawn only while G.captured is set, but beams only start when nothing is captured, so the beam would be invisible.
Captured ship is pushed into enemies at its capture spot and never moved; the red ship would hover near the bottom forever.
Shooting a Boss in formation does nothing to its captive (dead statement).
High score is read from localStorage but never written (no setItem).
P key is swallowed but no pause exists.
ships=3 plus the ship in play and game over at ships<0 gives four lives; three reserve icons shown at start.
Boss scores a flat 400 on destruction regardless of formation/escorts; 150/800/1600 never awarded.
Challenging whole-wave 1,000 bonus is credited twice (live and in finishChallenge).
Stage badges cycle 1,5,10,20,30,50 one per stage rather than denominating the stage number.
Hitboxes larger than the sprites (boss 17x14 box for a 12x7 sprite; player half-width 6 for a 9-px sprite).
'Breathing' is a sideways sway, not expand/contract.

summary: The file is well organised on the surface (named sections, data-driven sprites, a proper fixed-step loop, seven synthesized sounds, tractor-beam and challenging-stage scaffolding), but it dies on line 137 at load by passing a canvas where a row array is expected, so the player never sees anything but a black canvas. Reading past that crash, the core is also broken: the formation table is a list of single points that makes makeFormation throw on the first enemy, the rescue/dual path looks up the wrong id, the beam is drawn only after a capture, the captured ship never moves, the challenging stage freezes the player and then soft-locks on its result screen, and there is no GAME OVER or hit-results display and no high-score save. It reads like a plausible Galaga skeleton with several of the signature mechanics sketched but none wired correctly; as delivered it is not a game.
